clarification_question: I cannot see the scene. Please confirm: Is the green cup currently visible on the table? Is the gray tray visible, and does it have a clearly identifiable empty slot?

expected_effects: Update observability status of green_cup and gray_tray
Identify coordinates of tray_empty_slot if visible
Cup is lifted from initial surface
Cup is moved to vicinity of gray_tray
Cup is aligned above empty slot

goal_interpretation: Identify the green cup and the gray tray, locate an empty slot on the tray, transport the cup to that slot, place it down, and release it.

nodes.description: Initial state where objects are present but unverified due to lack of visual input.
unknown_conditions: Presence and location of green cup
Presence and orientation of gray tray
Availability of empty slots on the tray

nodes.description: Node representing the need to visually verify the scene contents.
unknown_conditions: Spatial relationship between cup and tray

nodes.description: State where the robot has successfully grasped the green cup.
State where the cup is positioned above the identified empty slot.
Final state where the green cup is placed in the gray tray and released.
unknown_conditions: Cup remains in slot after release

nodes.description: Fallback node if objects are not found or ambiguous.
unknown_conditions: User response to missing object query

objects.description: The target object to be moved, described as a green cup.
The target container with specific slots, described as a gray tray.
A specific vacant position within the gray tray structure.

physical_checks: Verify green_cup mass and center of mass for stable grasping
Check friction coefficient between gripper fingers and cup surface
Ensure gray_tray is stationary and fixed during placement
Validate that tray_empty_slot dimensions accommodate the green_cup base
Confirm no collision with tray walls during insertion
